pages.name: King's Pawn Game: King's Head Opening
pages.notes: Plan 4 named 'e2 or h3' as bare squares; reworded as Ne2/Nh3.

pages.name: King's Gambit Accepted: Allgaier, Schlechter Defense
pages.notes: Plan 3 suggested retreating the g5-knight to e4 (own pawn) or f3 (covered by g4); rewritten around the knight being short of retreats. Plan 4's 'threats along the h-file' replaced with the real ...h6 idea.

pages.name: Two Knights Defence, Traxler Counterattack
pages.notes: Overview called it a reply to the Fried Liver and ignored the 5.Bxf7+ Ke7 6.Bd5 line on the board; plan 2 proposed ...d5 with d5 occupied by White's bishop.

pages.name: Two Knights Defense, Ulvestad Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 called the f8-bishop light-squared and suggested queenside castling; plan 3 proposed ...c5-c4 with the pawn on c7.

pages.name: Spanish: Exchange, Gligoric, 6.d4 Bg4 7.c3
pages.notes: Plan 1 proposed an impossible f4-g4 advance; plan 3 claimed White controls the d-file and a d5 outpost after ...exd4, which c6 and cxd4 rule out.

pages.name: Spanish: Modern Steinitz, Siesta, 6.exf5
pages.notes: Overview called the Siesta a reply to the Modern Steinitz (it is a line of it) and 6.exf5 accepting a pawn; plan 2 named a rook on f8 that isn't there; plan 3 suggested queenside castling, not the standard O-O/Re1/d4.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Closed, Leonhardt Variation
pages.notes: Plan 2's ...Ng6 is impossible from f6; rerouted as ...Nbd7-f8-g6.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Closed, Chigorin, Yugoslav System
pages.notes: Plan 2 ...Bg7 from e7 is impossible (needs ...Bf8-g7); plan 3 described the Nf1-e3 manoeuvre already completed; plan 4 route b7-d8 written from the wrong square; overview said ...g6 controls dark squares (f5 is light).

pages.name: Nimzo-Indian: Nimzo-Queen's Hybrid
pages.notes: Plan 4 had Be2 and O-O with the e2-pawn blocking the bishop; plan 3 missed the main 5.Bg5.

pages.name: Nimzo-Indian: Classical, Noa, 5.cxd5 Qxd5 6.Nf3 Qf5 7.Qb3
pages.notes: Plan 3 proposed b4 with the queen on b3 blocking it; plan 4 credited Black with a bishop pair that White would get; plan 1 had Be2/O-O without e3.
